title: 安靜掌握新版更新
summary: SnapBar 會在背景檢查新版，以一次輕提醒告訴你更新的好處，並保留隨時可查看的下載入口。
highlights: 正式版與預覽版分流，每個版本只主動提醒一次，使用選字、AI 或 OCR 時延後提醒。
關於與支援提供手動檢查、更新摘要與下載入口，也能關閉自動檢查。
檢查只取得 GitHub 公開版本資訊，不傳送選取文字或剪貼簿內容。
usage: 使用公開版本後可到「關於與支援」查看更新；新版仍需先從系統匣結束舊版，再完整解壓縮並開啟，原設定會保留。

en.title: Quietly stay informed about updates
en.summary: SnapBar checks for new versions in the background, explains the benefits in a one-time reminder, and keeps a download entry available.
highlights: Stable and preview channels stay separate. Each version is announced once, with reminders deferred during selection, AI or OCR work.
About and support includes manual checks, release summaries and downloads, plus an option to turn automatic checks off.
Checks retrieve only public GitHub release information; selected text and clipboard contents are never sent.
en.usage: In a public build, open About and support to check for updates. Quit the old version from the tray, fully extract the new package, then open it. Existing settings are preserved.
